name: ledger
wording: the record of a context's cuts and their work packages, kept as an append-only sequence of events, each one transition of one cut or work package carrying an id of its own, so a transition recorded once is refused when repeated; its events are taken from the harness's own account of its agents as it happens, never from an agent remembering to record them: a work package is dispatched when its builder is dispatched, returned when its builder returns, and approved when its cut's assayers' verdicts return; a cut is in flight from its first dispatch and complete once every one of its work packages is approved; each cut's phase, its work packages' status and the work packages ready to dispatch next are computed from it on request; it is versioned with its cut's feature branch, so it shows the state of the branch being read and lands with the cut's merge.
reason: 0079: a cut lives on a feature branch, not a worktree. The operator, 2026-10-10: a cut needs a feature branch of its own and nothing more; worktrees are not the normal development workflow and add complexity and hygiene overhead, and agents already know how to branch.
